Once all heros in the party are out of hearts, that's a game over (back to cantina)'; docs/decisions-log.md 'Step 21: hearts'). How many hearts each hero has (`heroes`, by character kind; one left out has `default`). `per`: what costs one, 'fall' (an enemy puts the hero on the floor: the unit, D-020) or 'blow' (each blow an enemy lands; the other answer, kept one switch away). A friend, a wall, a fall and the cantina's brawl never cost one. When every party member is out it is game over: after `gameOver.beat` seconds (the last fall seen) everyone playing is in `gameOver.room` (a cantina: its pads) with every heart back, unless the place they lost in says otherwise (content/defeat/<place>.json `gameOver`). 'on': false is the game before hearts.
